name: Nerima (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Nerima ward emblem in white: a stylised angular device with a five-pointed star at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Nerima, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 January 1984; the emblem dates from 31 December 1953.

features.role: Nerima ward emblem — a stylised angular device with a five-pointed star at the top
